text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, it's that time of the year 
again...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing, so many cardboard boxes again 
this year! There are tons of veggies!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Alright, Ticket-san. Would you take this?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, no way! You can't do that! Didn't 
Jordan's mom send these to you!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, it even comes with a letter!! 
Jordan, you should eat it!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well... yeah, but still.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...No, there's no way. Cooking this would 
be way too much of a pain."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely share it with everyone at 
school. Ticket-san, gimme a hand tomorrow. 
We're gonna gift some to the cafeteria 
ladies.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh!? I told you, stooooop!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Jordan's Trainer!! Please take care of 
this!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket brought Tosen Jordan along, 
carrying a huge stack of cardboard boxes 
into the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright! Enjoy your meal!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ingredients for hot pot. My mom sends 'em 
over telling me to eat.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
There's crab and stuff too. Trainer, feel 
free to dig in.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. That's just Mama's hobby. 
Sending stuff to people and having them 
cook meals.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I told you I hate cooking...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inside the cardboard box, along with 
Chinese cabbage, carrots, and frozen 
seafood, are various other 
delicious-looking ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? I'm totally normal, though?
choice_data_list:
So it's more for you than your family, 
huh?

So it's more for you than your family, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Each ingredient was carefully wrapped. The 
included note also gave instructions on 
how to cook them in the microwave.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe so, but... ...Even if I just get 
food like this, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan crouched down and picked up 
one of the notes stuck to the cardboard 
box.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Like, 'Make sure to eat good food.' I 
mean, the academy's food is plenty 
delicious as it is.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
……I told you, you didn't have to walk me 
back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead, suit yourself~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, since we had the chance, we were 
making hot pot using the ingredients that 
came with it, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All done, all done~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was lame. Didn't feel like 
Christmas at all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanna eat Christmas chicken. Gonna 
go buy some.
choice_data_list: You're eating hot pot too, right?
You're eating hot pot too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, only if there's any left over~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah, a genius? You can cook, too?
choice_data_list: I just made it exactly as the memo said

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, if more gets sent next year, you're 
making it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you're just gonna eat, that's fine with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanna eat Christmas chicken. Gonna 
go buy some.
choice_data_list: You're eating hot pot too, right?
You're eating hot pot too, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, only if there's any left over~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, lol. You're throwing the whole 
thing in? That's so sloppy.
choice_data_list: That's what it said in the memo, so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Mom hates half-assed stuff like that, 
though. Total lie. It's just a drag for 
you, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Quit joking around~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey... are you listening~? Here's how to 
make it. Put water in the pot, toss in the 
dashi packet—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...So good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, this is hilarious. Eating hot 
pot with you? What is this, New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... No way, just no. There are just 
so many things wrong with this~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Aaalright, thanks for the meal~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'll at least give 'em a call. Just to 
say, 'I ate with Trainer.'

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Saying it was 'delicious.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Tosen Jordan started calling 
her parents' house from the trainer's 
office.
